name: Geometry-Texture-Aware Densification
definition: A densification framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses geometry priors (depth/normal) to guide splitting in weakly textured regions and texture gradients to control densification in fully textured areas, avoiding the over-splitting of floaters in textureless regions.
summary: Geometry-Texture-Aware Densification guides 3D Gaussian Splatting splitting using geometry priors and texture gradients to prevent over-splitting in textureless regions.
